items.title: Mystery over source of Ebola infection in Nigeria fuels concern about spread of virus

sentences.en: Switzerland says patient is wife of Swiss diplomat and believed to have contracted virus while travelling in Uganda Health officials across Africa are racing to determine how Nigeria’s first Ebola patient ⁠in more than a decade ⁠became infected, amid fears ​the outbreak could spread further after reaching a fourth African country.
sentences.zh: 瑞士表示，患者是瑞士外交官的妻子，据信在乌干达旅行时感染了病毒非洲各地的卫生官员正在竞相确定尼日利亚十多年来首位埃博拉患者是如何感染的，因为担心疫情可能会在到达第四个非洲国家后进一步蔓延。

sentences.en: The Swiss foreign ministry said on Friday the patient in Nigeria, the Ugandan-born wife of a Swiss diplomat based in Abuja, had not travelled to the Democratic Republic of ⁠Congo, where the outbreak was first detected in mid-May before spreading to Uganda, Kenya and now Nigeria.
sentences.zh: 瑞士外交部周五表示，尼日利亚的病人，一名驻阿布贾的瑞士外交官的乌干达出生的妻子，没有前往刚果民主共和国，那里的疫情于5月中旬首次被发现，然后蔓延到乌干达，肯尼亚和现在的尼日利亚。

sentences.en: The woman was believed to have contracted Ebola while travelling with her husband in Uganda, the ministry added.
sentences.zh: 该部补充说，据信这名妇女与丈夫在乌干达旅行时感染了埃博拉病毒。

items.title: Magnitude-7 earthquake hits Tibet, killing at least 16 and destroying hundreds of homes

sentences.en: Magnitude-7 earthquake hits Tibet, killing at least 16 and destroying hundreds of homes.
sentences.zh: 7级地震袭击了西藏，造成至少16人死亡，数百所房屋被毁。

sentences.en: Search and rescue efforts under way after quake strikes region’s north, with at least seven aftershocks recorded A magnitude-7 earthquake has hit Tibet, killing at least 16 people, injuring 54 and destroying hundreds of homes in the northern regional city of Nagqu, official media have said.
sentences.zh: 官方媒体称，在地震袭击西藏北部地区后，正在进行搜索和救援工作，至少发生了7次余震。7级地震袭击了西藏，造成至少16人死亡， 54人受伤，并摧毁了北部地区城市那曲的数百所房屋。

sentences.en: Search and rescue efforts continued after at least 339 homes and 20 livestock sheds collapsed, the Nagqu media office said, citing city government officials.
sentences.zh: 那曲媒体办公室援引市政府官员的话说，在至少339所房屋和20个牲畜棚倒塌后，搜索和救援工作仍在继续。

sentences.en: It was the biggest quake in the region in the past five years, according to China’s national broadcaster CCTV.
sentences.zh: 据中国国家广播电台中央电视台报道，这是过去五年来该地区最大的地震。

items.title: India slashes cost of cancer drugs after court rules mark-ups are ‘extortion’

sentences.en: India slashes cost of cancer drugs after court rules mark-ups are ‘extortion’.
sentences.zh: 印度削减抗癌药物的成本后，法院规则加价是“敲诈勒索”。

sentences.en: Case filed in 2022 by patient unable to afford medicine leads to cap on drug prices for millions who face ruin if diagnosed The Indian government has moved to reduce the price of cancer drugs after a retired bank clerk took her case to the supreme court.
sentences.zh: 2022年，无力负担药物费用的患者提起诉讼，导致数百万人面临破产的药品价格上限印度政府已经采取行动，降低癌症药物的价格，此前一名退休的银行职员将她的案件提交最高法院。

sentences.en: From next month, 137 cancer drugs in India will be cheaper as the government tries to tackle the tragedy of poorer patients either forgoing treatment, selling land or falling into debt to meet the high cost of some medicines, which are making large profits for hospitals and pharmacists.
sentences.zh: 从下个月开始，印度的137种抗癌药物将更便宜，因为政府试图解决较贫穷的患者放弃治疗，出售土地或陷入债务的悲剧，以满足某些药物的高成本，这些药物正在为医院和药剂师带来巨额利润。

sentences.en: High inflation, low growth and rising unemployment can be added to the federal treasurer’s wall of worries Get our new political email , free app or daily news podcast Jim Chalmers in a speech last week offered the scant encouragement that the economy would be “a bit better” in a year’s time.
sentences.zh: 高通胀、低增长和不断上升的失业率可能会被添加到联邦财政部长的担忧墙上。在上周的一次演讲中，我们的新政治电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客吉姆·查尔默斯（ Jim Chalmers ）几乎没有鼓励经济在一年内“好一点”。

sentences.en: Fast forward to Friday morning, and the treasurer revealed that his officials were busy downgrading their forecasts ahead of December’s mid-year budget update to show slower growth and higher unemployment.

sentences.en: Our Latin America correspondent, Tom Phillips, heads to Roraima to hear what’s at stake for the rainforest and the communities that live there in the Brazilian presidential runoff on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 我们的拉丁美洲记者汤姆·菲利普斯（ Tom Phillips ）前往罗赖马（ Roraima ） ，在周日的巴西总统决选中了解热带雨林和生活在那里的社区的利害关系。

sentences.en: Send your comments and questions to tif.questions@theguardian.com For the Amazon and the communities who live there, the stakes in Sunday’s Brazilian presidential election runoff could scarcely be higher.
sentences.zh: 将您的意见和问题发送到tif.questions@theguardian.com对于亚马逊和居住在那里的社区来说，周日巴西总统选举决赛的风险几乎不会更高。

sentences.zh: 我们的拉丁美洲记者汤姆·菲利普斯（ Tom Phillips ）前往该国最北部的罗赖马州，听取该地区选民、传教士和政治家的意见，该地区在第一轮投票中大力支持弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ）。

sentences.en: 41-year-old set on ‘dream to be able to race in Africa’ Rwanda to host despite criticism of human rights record Lewis Hamilton has said he hopes to remain racing in Formula One until he can take part in the African Grand Prix which is set to take place in Rwanda in the 2030s .

sentences.en: It is lined up to be held on a circuit in Bugesera, 25 miles south of the capital, Kigali, which has yet to be constructed and marks a return to the African continent for the first time since it last held a race at Kyalami, South Africa in 1993.
sentences.zh: 它将在首都基加利以南25英里的Bugesera的一条赛道上举行，该赛道尚未建成，标志着自1993年上一次在南非Kyalami举行比赛以来首次重返非洲大陆。

items.title: AWS Continuum for code vulnerabilities is now generally available

sentences.en: AWS Continuum for code vulnerabilities is now generally available.
sentences.zh: 针对代码漏洞的AWS Continuum现已全面推出。

sentences.en: Today, we’re announcing the general availability of AWS Continuum for code vulnerabilities .
sentences.zh: 今天，我们宣布AWS Continuum针对代码漏洞全面推出。

sentences.en: AWS Continuum is a security service that finds and validates code vulnerabilities, then delivers fixes as patches you can automate or as pull requests in your repositories.
sentences.zh: AWS Continuum是一种安全服务，可查找和验证代码漏洞，然后以修补程序的形式提供修补程序，您可以自动执行修补程序，也可以在存储库中提取请求。

sentences.en: AWS Continuum for code vulnerabilities confirms which findings are exploitable in your environment, ranks the resulting issues by business impact, and proposes a fix for each one.
sentences.zh: 针对代码漏洞的AWS Continuum可确认您环境中哪些发现可被利用，按业务影响对由此产生的问题进行排名，并为每个问题提出修复建议。

sentences.en: Every remediation starts in a mode where Continuum proposes the fix and a person approves it before it ships.
sentences.zh: 每种补救措施都始于Continuum提出补救措施并在发货前获得人员批准的模式。

sentences.en: In the future, you will be able to decide which actions Continuum can take on its own, within the guardrails you define.
sentences.zh: 将来，您将能够在您定义的护栏内决定Continuum可以自行采取哪些行动。

sentences.en: Using frontier artificial intelligence (AI) models, threat actors can turn a vulnerability disclosure into working exploit code in minutes, and the same tools that speed up development also increase the volume of findings your teams must process.
sentences.zh: 使用前沿人工智能(AI)模型，威胁行为者可以在几分钟内将漏洞披露转化为工作漏洞利用代码，而加速开发的相同工具也会增加团队必须处理的调查结果数量。

sentences.en: If your organization runs a large application estate, your scanners likely produce thousands of findings a day, and many of them need no action.
sentences.zh: 如果您的组织运营着一个大型应用程序园区，您的扫描仪每天可能会产生数千个发现，其中许多无需采取任何行动。

sentences.en: A finding can be unreachable, unexploitable, or already mitigated by a runtime control.
sentences.zh: 发现可能无法访问、无法利用或已被运行时控件缓解。

sentences.en: Generic severity scores don’t tell you which resources a threat actor can actually reach, so a critical score on a dev-only utility looks the same as a medium score on a service one step away from a payments database.
sentences.zh: 一般的严重程度分数不会告诉您威胁行为者实际上可以访问哪些资源，因此仅限开发的实用程序的关键分数看起来与距离支付数据库仅一步之遥的服务的中等分数相同。

sentences.en: Previously, confirming whether a finding was exploitable took hours of manual investigation, and shipping a fix with confidence took days of coordination across security, infrastructure, and application teams, because the blast radius of a change is hard to assess without business context.
sentences.zh: 以前，确认发现是否可利用需要数小时的人工调查，而满怀信心地交付修复需要数天时间在安全、基础设施和应用程序团队之间进行协调，因为如果没有业务背景，很难评估变更的爆炸半径。

sentences.en: To close that gap, Continuum proves which findings are exploitable and bounds the risk of each fix it proposes.
sentences.zh: 为了缩小这一差距， Continuum证明了哪些发现是可以利用的，并限制了它提出的每个修复的风险。

items.title: How bug bounty sharpens one researcher’s security skills

sentences.en: How bug bounty sharpens one researcher’s security skills.
sentences.zh: 漏洞赏金如何提高一名研究人员的安全技能。

sentences.en: As Cybersecurity Awareness Month continues, the GitHub Bug Bounty team is excited to spotlight another top-performing security researcher from the GitHub Security Bug Bounty Program: @r31n !
sentences.zh: 随着网络安全意识月持续进行， GitHub Bug Bounty团队很高兴关注GitHub安全漏洞赏金计划的另一位表现最佳的安全研究员： @ r31n ！

sentences.en: As home to the world s developers, GitHub is dedicated to the security and reliability of the code behind millions of projects, and our Bug Bounty Program remains a cornerstone of that commitment.
sentences.zh: 作为全球开发者的家园， GitHub致力于数百万个项目背后的代码的安全性和可靠性，我们的漏洞赏金计划仍然是这一承诺的基石。

sentences.en: Collaboration with external researchers is one of the most effective ways to improve security, and every year, the community helps us identify and fix vulnerabilities that make the platform safer for everyone.
sentences.zh: 与外部研究人员合作是提高安全性的最有效方法之一，每年，社区都会帮助我们识别和修复漏洞，使平台更安全。

sentences.en: The security research landscape is changing rapidly.
sentences.zh: 安全研究格局正在迅速变化。

sentences.en: AI has lowered the barrier to entry and become a genuine force multiplier.
sentences.zh: 人工智能降低了进入门槛，成为真正的力量倍增器。

sentences.en: We use it across our own internal security programs, and we welcome researchers who do the same .
sentences.zh: 我们在自己的内部安全计划中使用它，我们欢迎研究人员也这样做。

sentences.en: However, what separates great research has not changed: validation, a working proof of concept, and a clear demonstration of real security impact.
sentences.zh: 然而，伟大研究的区别并没有改变：验证，概念的工作证明，以及对真实安全影响的清晰演示。

sentences.en: The tools do not matter; the quality of the work does.
sentences.zh: 工具无关紧要；工作的质量才是。

sentences.en: The researchers we spotlight this month exemplify exactly that standard through findings that are verified, reproducible, and demonstrate that a security boundary has been crossed rather than simply theorizing that one exists.
sentences.zh: 我们本月聚焦的研究人员通过经过验证、可重现的研究结果证明了这一标准，并证明安全边界已被跨越，而不是简单地推测存在安全边界。

sentences.en: Researchers who consistently work at that level can earn an invitation to our permanent VIP program, which offers higher payouts, faster response times, and early previews of beta products and features.
sentences.zh: 始终在这个级别工作的研究人员可以获得加入我们永久VIP计划的邀请，该计划可提供更高的收款、更快的响应时间以及测试版产品和功能的早期预览。

sentences.en: Learn more about how to qualify on our public bounty site .
sentences.zh: 在我们的公开赏金网站上了解更多有关如何获得资格的信息。

items.title: Revealed: billionaire Reform donor was in business with foundation linked to Iranian regime

sentences.en: Revealed: billionaire Reform donor was in business with foundation linked to Iranian regime.
sentences.zh: 透露：亿万富翁改革捐赠者与与伊朗政权有关的基金会开展业务。

sentences.en: Exclusive: Sasan Ghandehari’s partnership with religious foundation raises questions about past dealings with republic criticised by Nigel Farage Nigel Farage’s newest billionaire donor was in business with a powerful Iranian religious foundation under the authority of the country’s supreme leader, raising questions about his past dealings with the hardline republic.
sentences.zh: 独家：萨桑·甘德哈里（ Sasan Ghandehari ）与宗教基金会的合作伙伴关系引发了人们对他过去与共和国打交道的质疑，奈杰尔·法拉奇（ Nigel Farage ）批评了奈杰尔·法拉奇（ Nigel Farage ）的最新亿万富翁捐赠者，他在该国最高领导人的授权下与一个强大的伊朗宗教基金会开展业务，这引发了人们对他过去与强硬派共和国打交道的质疑

sentences.en: Hossein Ghandehari, also called Sasan, was little known in the UK until he pledged to give millions to Reform UK this summer and donated £50,000 to Farage to cover the cost of two passes for the Davos World Economic Forum.
sentences.zh: Hossein Ghandehari ，也被称为Sasan ，在英国鲜为人知，直到他承诺今年夏天向Reform UK捐赠数百万美元，并向Farage捐赠5万英镑，以支付达沃斯世界经济论坛的两张通行证的费用。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读
